## Future algorithms (roadmap)

> Not yet started — comfort is ⚪ by definition; the value is the WHY. Reference: the
> phase-plan table in [`study_guide.md`](../study_guide.md). Hand-authored; edit freely.

| Algorithm | Comfort | Opens | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Interval merge / sweep | ⚪ | Aug 24 | Primer delivered Aug 20 (sort-by-key turns O(n²) overlap into one pass; *which key* is the whole difficulty). First rep Aug 24 measures whether the recognition call fires. |
| Greedy (exchange argument) | ⚪ | Aug 24 | Primer delivered Aug 20. The instinct exists from Dijkstra/Hierholzer (*commit and never revisit*); naming it once should transfer. Greedy-vs-DP is the discriminator that also gates the DP phase. |
| Backtracking (DFS + prune + undo) | ⚪ | Sep 14 | Not started. 22 Generate Parentheses moved here from Stack as the gentlest entry. The load-bearing habit is *undo the choice on the way back up*. |
| 1D Dynamic Programming | ⚪ | Oct 12 | Not started — the phase the concept-primer mechanism was built to serve. Told apart from Greedy by *commit vs reconsider*; expect the recurrence-definition step to be the hard part, not the code. |
| 2D Dynamic Programming | ⚪ | Nov 9 | Not started. Grid / LCS / edit-distance / knapsack-table. Builds directly on 1D; the new difficulty is choosing the two state dimensions. |
